author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Territory War

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. For three or four players use Host a room for 3 or 4 players under Other ways to connect: the game starts once everyone has joined.
Your friends type the code in Join by code, or pick your room in the Rooms list.
The host sets up a Custom Battle with the mouse; everyone then plays their turns from the keyboard.

keys.key: 1 to 4, X, V, U, Y, N
keys.does: Pick a weapon and the game's other commands.

tips: Custom Battle Player 1 against Player 2 is hot-seat: every player uses the same keys on their own PC, one turn at a time.
Only the host's mouse works in the menus.
Everyone needs the same Ruffle Together build and game file; the launcher keeps them current.

description: Afro-Ninja's stick-figure team battle: walk, aim and throw grenades, shoot and kick on your turn. Online play runs in Ruffle Together: the host sets up the match and friends play their turns from the keyboard.

offline.description: Campaign, challenges and battles on this PC
